Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the directors’ birth dates. Despite correctly retrieving that Gus Van Sant was born on July 24, 1952 and Massimo Ceccherini on May 23, 1965, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Van Sant was born later by comparing only month/day and ignoring the year. Since 1965 is later than 1952, Lucignolo’s director was born later.
